title: AC1/T1.2 require a StatusCallback URL on every send; code makes the base URL optional and can omit it
evidence:
case sid, token, alpha_sender {
    Some(sid), Some(token), Some(alpha_sender) ->
      Enabled(TwilioConfig(... status_callback_base_url: base_url |> option.unwrap(""),))
    _, _, _ -> { ... Disabled }
--- AC1 (same diff) ---
then it `POST`s to the Twilio Messages resource ... and a `StatusCallback` URL
--- T1.2 (same diff) ---
reads ... TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL via envoy; returns Disabled when any required key is absent
detail: AC1 mandates a StatusCallback URL on every send and T1.2 lists base_url among the four required keys, but init() keeps the client Enabled with an empty base_url, so build_send_request omits StatusCallback entirely.
recommended_fix: Make TWILIO_STATUS_CALLBACK_BASE_URL required in init() (Disabled when absent) per T1.2, or update AC1/T1.2 to document StatusCallback as conditionally omitted.

title: T1.4 specifies parsing sid/status; only sid is decoded
detail: T1.4 says parse sid/status, but parse_send_response decodes only sid and SendOutcome carries no status. The Twilio response status (queued/failed) is never read.
recommended_fix: Decode and expose status (log it, or add it to SendOutcome), or amend T1.4 to drop the status requirement.
